name: ACB_Bench
description:
ACB_Bench
	

ACB_Bench is a query-only adversarial benchmark for evaluating access-control compliance of LLMs under role-based access control (RBAC). Each example specifies a user role and an explicit RBAC permission matrix, and provides a natural-language query that may be benign or adversarial. The label (expected_behavior) indicates whether the model should ALLOW or DENY the request under the given permissions. reputation: A specialized Hugging Face dataset for access-control compliance testing of LLMs with limited but growing use in safety/security evaluations.
